description: Defines hardware timing constants and inline functions for the nRF52820 radio controller, including delay calculations and power settings.

methods.description: Performs radio hardware reset or initialization.

methods.name: hal_radio_stop
methods.description: Performs cleanup actions for radio hardware.

methods.name: hal_radio_ram_prio_setup
methods.description: Sets up RAM priority for various radio components.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_power_floor
